protocol.policy_seed: 80000+episode*100+1 for the one subsequent RK-Diffuser pull sample
protocol.role: Exploratory mechanism intervention on previously inspected val20, one seed, expert goals
protocol.scope: Frozen original grasp sample; only last25% nominal grasp time can change before closure; no regrasp or recovery

groups.ORIGINAL: Unmodified original RML commands; original closure time
groups.HOLD: Same original commands, hold original final joint target for1s before closure
groups.XYZ: Smooth suffix XYZ retarget to expert position, preserve original planned orientation;1s measured-tip servo
groups.SE3: Smooth suffix position+orientation retarget to expert pose;1s measured-tip SE3 servo

protocol.subsequent_policy: Same frozen RK-Diffuser, expert pull target, seed and original controller; condition on each actual post-grasp observation. Do not replay an obsolete pull start posture.
protocol.measurement: True robot joint/EE state for bounded preclose servo; no visual module or object contact feedback used for correction
protocol.denominator: All20 per condition, including infeasible/insufficient pose correction, invalid plans and task failures
protocol.infrastructure: Fresh native simulator/model process per case; completed JSON saved before shutdown; preserve all attempts in separate paths, never overwrite partial artifacts
